div.font:
pg_hba: hostssl … scram-sha-256 clientcert=verify-full
the certificate CN must equal the role name — roles webapp / apiapp,
both members of appuser, which holds the table privileges

fields name / email / phone: pgp_sym_encrypt (AES-256) + HMAC for search
files: SSE-C — the object store never keeps the key
all keys come from environment variables, never from the database
